snippet.title: New Home | Experience Solitude, Redemption, Hope and Friendship | PC
snippet.description:
New Home | Experience Solitude, Redemption, Hope and Friendship | PC
#pcgaming #indiegame #gaming #horrorgaming 

Buy Game - https://danielgrimaldi.itch.io/new-home

During very tough times of being lonely and depressed, you feel like you have nothing left to lose anymore...  until a new friend comes along...


A game made by a 16 year old, inspired by a viral clip posted by Zach Hargadon of a sad claymation mouse eating M&M's alone, taken from the first episode Feeding Time of the YouTube series Creature Comforts


In this narrative-driven game, you will explore themes such as solitude, redemption, hope, friendship, and finding comfort in the most unexpected companions.
Will you have the strength to confront your past and find peace in your wounded soul?

SONG
New Home by Austin Farwell
